context:
Goal: a message you repeat is never missed by the repeat checker, and never blocks a session for nothing.
Problem (rule): when the model errors or answers in the wrong shape, the lane keeps the message unchecked so the next stop sends it again; no ruling covers this.
Based on (read): main marks a message checked after one try, answer or not.
Departs from: main checks each message once — the change checks again at each stop until the model gives a usable answer.

options.gain: A model hiccup never hides a message you repeated.
options.how: A message with no usable answer stays unchecked and goes to the model again at the next stop.
options.label: Try again at each stop (lane's pick)
options.lose: A message that keeps failing costs one more model call per stop until it works.

options.gain: Always one model call per message.
options.how: A message is marked checked after one try, even with no answer.
options.label: Check once, as main does
options.lose: A repeat is missed whenever the model hiccups.
